name: Bloodthirsty Adversary
oracle_text:
Haste
When this creature enters, you may pay {2}{R} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature, then exile up to that many target instant and/or sorcery cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard and copy them. You may cast any number of the copies without paying their mana costs.

needs.what: a resolution-time optional payment of a multi-symbol mana cost ({2}{R}) a player-chosen number of times (0..affordable), binding the count paid so ONE reflexive trigger ('when you pay this cost one or more times') can read it for 'that many' +1/+1 counters and a variable 'up to that many' target count
needs.why_existing_wont_do: may.any_amount is exactly this shape but the loader (_validate_pay_any_amount) refuses any pay.mana that is not exactly one coloured or {C} symbol, so {2}{R} cannot be scaled; may.repeat asks again after each payment but runs the effects (and so the reflexive trigger) once per payment, giving N separate one-counter, one-target triggers instead of one trigger reading the total, and binds no count; pay.times is a computed multiplier, not a chosen one; may.x adds X as generic mana
